description: Reads a Sitecore item by ID or path over the Authoring and Management API, returning its identity, template and field values. Reads the authoring database, so unpublished content is visible — unlike the Edge query tools. Supply exactly one of id or path.

database.description: The database to read. Defaults to the endpoint's own default (master).

excludeStandardFields.description: When true (the default), omit Sitecore's standard fields (__Created, __Workflow and the rest). Set false when you need one of them.

id.description: The item's GUID, e.g. '{110D559F-DEA5-42EA-9C1C-8A5DF7E70EF9}'. Supply this or path.

ownFields.description: When true (the default), return only fields defined on the item's own template rather than every inherited field.

path.description: The item's full path, e.g. '/sitecore/content/Home'. Supply this or id.

version.description: The item version. Defaults to the latest.

name: authoring-get-item
